name: I.H.Carruthers Ltd (Eveni Carruthers)
note: Apia department-store and apparel company founded in 1929 by Irving 'Eveni' Carruthers; per its own site it is a family company managed by the founder's fourth generation. Brands include Eveni Pacific (Elei apparel), Eveni Kids, KokoPacific, EveniSport and Eveni school uniforms. No shareholding listing is publicly searchable for Samoa.
